note: The RC-9A debt manifest (ratified 2026-08-28, consolidated at the S0-8 regeneration). Every property Stage 0 defers to a later gate is exactly one entry here; a gate consults this file and blocks while its debt is unpaid, expired or input-changed; an entry leaves only by a payment record or a recorded waiver; what-blocks-what is computed from these entries on demand (pnpm debts), never transcribed beside them. Read back by scripts/check-debts.mjs (pnpm debts:check, in pnpm check) and consumed by scripts/check-traceability.mjs for its owed rows. Inputs are pinned by hash12 of the file, or of the named section under the authority-map slicing rule; a changed input fails the check until the entry is re-read and re-pinned or amended.

debts.property: A dated SubtleCrypto readback of TRD §10.11's four X25519 operations across the four core engines — the section's rule is a floor with evidence and a date, and its evidence table is deliberately empty until this lands.
debts.owner: review 3b intake (TRD §10.11 offers that pass the measurement; row 12's authenticator survey shares it)
debts.artifact: TRD §10.11's evidence table, populated: engine × operation rows each carrying source, date and expiry
debts.falsifier: an empty, undated, unsourced or expired table fails the S0-10 evaluation that reads it; a browser-version citation or an assertion from memory is refused as payment

payment_record.source: web-platform-tests stable desktop runs, read 2026-08-29 via wpt.fyi — https://wpt.fyi/results/WebCryptoAPI?run_ids=5176987542093824,5102565221203968,4788146637373440,5172112754212864 (Chrome 152.0.7977.64 run 5176987542093824, started 2026-08-28 · Edge 152.0.4191.53 run 5102565221203968, 2026-08-29 · Firefox 154.0.1 run 4788146637373440, 2026-08-27 · Safari 26.6 run 5172112754212864, 2026-08-27); executions of the four SubtleCrypto operations, never a version citation
payment_record.artifact: docs/TRD.md §10.11's evidence table — 16 engine × operation rows, each with source, date and expiry; check-debts.mjs holds the table and this record to each other in both directions
payment_record.note: Every success-path row passes on all four engines. Firefox 154's deriveBits reads pass 12/19: the six small-order all-zero rejection subtests and the non-multiple-of-8 length subtest miss while every positive derivation (pkcs8/spki import, deriveBits at length 256) passes — recorded in the table's dagger note, with the consequence that the Stage-4 DHKEM layer carries its own RFC 9180 all-zero abort on every engine.

debts.property: The known old-origin plaintext cutover as one resumable transaction — export, import, active-store selection, deletion, restart — with its kill matrix executed and no plaintext left at any kill point.
debts.artifact: the executed kill matrix over the cutover state machine, with a residue scan at every kill point
debts.falsifier: a kill point after which plaintext remains, or a resume that cannot complete or roll back, fails the matrix; design prose without an executed matrix is refused as payment

debts.property: A declared hardware population under the journal p95 budget — Baseline stays a compatibility policy and never becomes a performance floor; slower supported devices are sampled, not inferred.
debts.artifact: the declared device population with raw journal p95 samples measured on it
debts.falsifier: a Baseline citation, or the single Pixel, presented as the population fails the evaluation; the budget claim must rest on samples from the declared population

debts.property: The audit's exact scope: the 2019 snapshot diffed to the locked 0.10.1 graph, with review 3a naming what it evaluated — the audit preserved as related history, never as exact-version proof.
debts.artifact: the source-delta review from the audited snapshot to the locked graph, with reviewer 3a's named scope and readback
debts.falsifier: the 2019 audit citation cannot mark this paid without the exact commit-to-0.10.1 delta and review 3a's named scope; a citation alone is refused as payment

debts.property: The provenance residue after the S0-8 header binding: reproducible rebuild — the same bytes from the same source under a pinned or attested toolchain — with blob attestation. The toolchain-free source↔blob drift binding landed in wasm:verify and detects drift, never forgery; a builder that lies about hashes, or a compromised toolchain, is exactly this residue.
debts.artifact: an attested reproduction: pinned toolchain identity, the rebuilt blob's hash equal to the shipped hash, and the attestation binding them
debts.falsifier: a green KAT, or the drift binding itself, cannot mark this paid — the payment is a reproduced build under a pinned toolchain, receipted; anything less is refused

debts.property: The immutable append burst measured on the declared device population at production-shaped occupancy — the fixed-slot microbenchmark stays useful history, never product-shaped append evidence. Causally RC-3's; registered here, never double-counted.
debts.artifact: raw append-burst samples on the declared population, with occupancy and cleanup stated (test/latency/journal-bench.ts is the bench; no gate below test:latency runs it, so its claim lives here rather than as a falsifier tag)
debts.falsifier: a hot-key or single-device measurement presented as the burst fails the evaluation; the samples must come from the declared population at stated occupancy
